// A fixture, not a module: this is what a wrong-direction import looks like when
// somebody writes one. It stands in for `packages/shared/src/telemetry-bridge.ts`
// — a shared-layer file that reaches UP into a runtime because the type it
// wanted happened to be declared there.
//
// The example below is inside a comment and must NOT count as an edge:
//   import { runDrain } from "@reddb-io/dev";

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import type { RepoInvariantSuite } from "@reddb-io/dev";
import { renderDashboard } from "../../../apps/plugin-dev/src/core/boot.js";

export function describeSuites(path: string): string {
  const suites = readFileSync(path, "utf8");
  const rendered: RepoInvariantSuite[] = [];
  return renderDashboard(suites, rendered);
}
